title: BNPL Late Fee & Penalty Compliance Calculator
description: Compare BNPL late fee and default charge structures against regulatory caps: FCA HCSTC £15 hard cap, FCA CONC 7 proportionality test, EU CCD2 Art. 33 default charge limits, CFPB Reg Z proportionality, and NY DFS BNPL guidance. Converts percentage fees to flat equivalents and calculates remediation exposure for non-compliant structures.

flat_fee.description: Flat fee amount per default event. Required when fee_type is 'flat'.

pct_fee.description: Fee as percentage of outstanding balance. Required when fee_type is 'percentage'.

avg_balance.description: Average outstanding balance at time of default. Required for percentage fee conversion.

remediation_customers.description: Estimated number of customers charged non-compliant fees. Optional — enables remediation exposure calculation.

remediation_months.description: Number of months of non-compliant charging. Optional.

events_per_customer_per_month.description: Average missed payment events per customer per month. Default 0.5. Industry range: 0.3–0.8.

worst_status.description: Worst compliance status across all assessed regimes.

remediation_total.description: Estimated total remediation exposure in reporting currency. 0 if remediation inputs not provided.

mcp_tool_definition.name: calculate_bnpl_late_fee_compliance
mcp_tool_definition.description: Check whether a BNPL late fee structure complies with FCA CONC 7 / HCSTC £15 hard cap, EU CCD2 Art. 33 default charge limits, CFPB Reg Z proportionality, and NY DFS BNPL guidance. Converts percentage fees to flat equivalents, returns per-regime compliance status (Compliant / At Risk / Non-Compliant), excess over cap, and estimated remediation exposure. Use when a BNPL provider needs to validate or remediate a late fee schedule.

uk_hcstc.citation: FCA CONC 7B.4.1R — HCSTC default fee cap £15 per event (FCA PS14/16, effective Jan 2015)

uk_standard.citation: FCA CONC 7.7.4R — fees must not exceed costs reasonably incurred; £25 indicative proxy from FCA CP23/5 market data

eu_ccd2.citation: CCD2 Art. 33 — default charges must be fair and proportionate; national member state caps vary

us_cfpb.citation: 12 CFR 1026 / CFPB Supervisory Highlights Spring 2023 — fees >$30 on small BNPL transactions flagged

ny_dfs.citation: NY DFS BNPL Supervisory Guidance June 2023 §2 — fees must be reasonable and proportionate

status_thresholds.compliant: fee <= proxy (or hard cap for HCSTC)
status_thresholds.at_risk: no hard cap AND proxy < fee <= proxy × 1.5
status_thresholds.non_compliant: fee > hard cap OR fee > proxy × 1.5

notes: Client-side. Zero PII. All cap data is embedded. The £15 HCSTC cap is a published FCA hard limit; all other proxies are indicative. Last reviewed: 2026-05-08.
